faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.sub: Clear answers regarding sessions, privacy, and technology.
faq.q1: How does the AI mock interview work?
faq.a1: You upload your CV and enter the job title or course topic. Our system generates tailored questions, listens to your spoken answers in real-time, asks contextual follow-ups, and delivers a diagnostic report.
faq.q2: Can I speak in Bangla or a mix of Bangla and English?
faq.a2: Yes! Abhoyy is tuned for Bangladesh. You can choose full English, full Bangla, or natural mixed Bengali-English conversational mode.
faq.q3: Is my CV and video recording kept private?
faq.a3: Strictly private. Your CV and mock recordings are accessible only by you in your dashboard. We do not sell or publish user practice recordings.
faq.q4: How do I pay with bKash?
faq.a4: At checkout, choose your plan, send money to our verified bKash merchant number, and enter your transaction ID for instant credit verification.
faq.q5: Does Abhoyy guarantee I will pass my actual viva or interview?
faq.a5: No. Abhoyy is an independent practice and preparation tool. We do not guarantee hiring, selection, or specific exam results.

prep.title: Preparation Checklist
prep.sub: Complete each checkpoint before entering the interview room.
prep.1: Use a laptop if you can, with good earphones and a microphone.
prep.why1: Earphones eliminate room echo and ensure your voice is captured with clear articulation.
prep.2: Sit where light falls on your face and the room is quiet.
prep.why2: Front-facing light ensures clear camera analysis; a quiet room prevents background noise confusion.
prep.3: On a phone, use a tripod or a stable stand at eye level.
prep.why3: Holding your phone leads to shaky footage and unnatural neck angles during speaking.
prep.4: Speak a little louder than usual, and speak with confidence.
prep.why4: Projecting your voice demonstrates authority and helps the speech recognition capture every word accurately.
prep.5: Use Abhoyy to improve yourself. It is practice, not a final verdict.
prep.why5: Treat mistakes as cost-free data. Every stumble here is a mistake avoided in front of the real board.
prep.6: Keep a stable internet connection and a charged device.
prep.why6: Prevents video drops or buffering interruptions while the AI panel is speaking.
prep.allCheckedNotice: All 6 requirements completed. You are ready to proceed.
prep.mustCheckAll: Please review and acknowledge all 6 recommendations to unlock the interview room.

deviceCheck.title: Device & Audio Check
deviceCheck.sub: Verify your camera, microphone, and internet connection.
deviceCheck.cameraDarkWarning: Lighting is dim. Face a window or lamp so your face is bright.
deviceCheck.micInstruction: Say your name out loud to test sound reception.
deviceCheck.micTooQuiet: A little louder, please. Speak as if you were in the real room.
deviceCheck.micGood: Microphone level is clear and balanced.
deviceCheck.micTooLoud: Input is slightly loud. Adjust distance from microphone.
deviceCheck.connectionSlow: Low bandwidth detected. Audio will prioritize speech clarity.
deviceCheck.permDeniedAndroid: On Chrome Android: Tap the lock icon in the address bar > Permissions > Allow Camera and Microphone.
deviceCheck.permDeniedIos: On Safari iOS: Tap AA in address bar > Website Settings > Camera & Microphone > Allow.
deviceCheck.permDeniedDesktop: On Desktop Chrome: Click the icon next to the URL > Reset permissions > Refresh page.
